outcome: Soluble SC5b-9 complement activity in plasma
finding: Soluble SC5b-9 complement complex levels were increased in the plasma of women during term labor, preterm labor, and PPROM compared to women not in labor, and active complement C5b-9 complexes were deposited on fetal membranes in women who delivered vaginally, but not in those who had non-labor cesarean sections.
mod_finding: Women who underwent non-labor-indicated Cesarean sections did not exhibit complement deposition.
